tools.name: skill_route
tools.description: Pick the skills relevant to a request, instead of putting every skill in the prompt. Three retrievers are available and can be switched or combined: `lexical` (BM25, local and free, best for English descriptions), `ngram` (character n-grams, needed for Chinese where there are no spaces), `jev` (a decision model that answers "is this skill needed" as a probability; most accurate, costs money). `hybrid` runs all three and merges by rank.

limit.description: How many skills to return. Default 5.

method.description: Which mechanism decides what to load. Four modes, plus three single-retriever modes for testing them in isolation. `full` loads everything (no selection at all); `regex` applies rules without any model; `jev` asks a decision model for each skill whether it is needed; `llm` asks a language model to pick from the whole catalog at once. Default: whatever NGU_SKILL_MODE says, else `hybrid`.

query.description: The user request, verbatim. Do not summarise it: the retrievers match on the words the user actually used.

tools.name: skill_list
tools.description: List the skills that exist, with the checks the Agent Skills specification requires (agentskills.io/specification): `name` must be 1-64 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, and must not start or end with a hyphen or contain a doubled hyphen; `description` must be non-empty and at most 1024 characters. Reports violations rather than hiding them.

check.description: Run the specification checks and report violations. Default true.
